description: This file defines the NotesImportTask class responsible for importing notes from a remote API into the local repository within the Android client of Nextcloud Notes. It manages asynchronous fetching of note IDs and individual notes, updating import status, and handling errors.

classes.name: NotesImportTask
classes.description: Handles the process of importing notes from a remote API into the local repository, managing threading, status updates, and error handling.

methods.name: NotesImportTask
methods.description: Constructor initializing the import task with context, repository, account, executor, and API provider.

methods.name: importNotes
methods.description: Starts the asynchronous import process, returning LiveData of import status and invoking callback upon completion or error.
